description: A jumper wire with a pin on one end and a socket on the other.
how_to_use: Slide the socket end over a stiff component pin (a potentiometer or module pin) and push the pin end into an Arduino header socket — a solderless connection with no breadboard.

plain.what: A jumper wire with a pin on one end and a socket on the other.
plain.how: Use it to connect a part with pins sticking out (like a sensor module) straight to a breadboard or Arduino.
